description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 18, 2016 Contact: Mike Trujillo Mike[at]barraganforcongress[dot]com Compton Herald endorses Nanette Barragán for Congress SAN PEDRO, CA – This morning, the Compton Herald announced its support for Nanette Barragán for Congress. “Unbought, uncompromised, unbeholden to special interest groups, Nanette Barragán is the Compton Herald’s choice for Congress,” praised Senator Hall’s hometown paper.
title: Compton Herald endorses Nanette Barragán for Congress - Nanette Barragan For Congress (CA-44)
